LESSON: LISTENING AND SPEAKING 8.1.1 LISTENING COMPREHENSION : EXPLANATORY NARRATIVES

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 8
Topic 8.1: Listening and Speaking 8.1.1 Listening Comprehension : Explanatory Narratives
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 1

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 8.1.1 Listening Comprehension : Explanatory Narratives, part of Strand 8 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade seven ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How can you tell a lesson that you can learn from a narrative? 2.Why do people tell narratives?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening and Speaking 8.1.1 Listening Comprehension : Explanatory Narratives together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Digital literacy: A learner manipulates digital devices with assistive technology and use them to create stories and

share them with others

• Communication and collaboration: A learner speaks clearly and effectively as learners dramatise narratives and

discuss moral lessons.

Values:
Patriotism: A learner listens and respond to explanatory narratives and moral lessons and relating them to their real

life, thereby becoming better citizens.

Link to other subjects:

● Social studies also emphasise the application of moral lessons.

● Performing arts also employs role-playing narratives in performances.
